data.title: How a Seed Grows
data.passage: First, a tiny seed is planted in the dark soil. Next, the warm rain makes the ground wet. After that, a little green shoot pushes up into the bright sun. Later, green leaves open wide to catch the golden light. Finally, tall stems reach high toward the sky.

keyIdeas.text: A tiny seed is placed deep in the dark soil.
Warm rain makes the dry ground very wet.
A little green shoot pushes up toward the sun.
Green leaves open wide to catch the golden light.
Tall stems reach high toward the open sky.
